observedCases.detail: Published example is GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} against serverUrl https://api.github.com with statusCode 200, contentType application/json, and example.full_name octocat/Hello-World. progAccess.allowsPublicRead is true. Replay uses this stored example; the live API was not called.

statusCodes lists 301 Moved permanently, 403 Forbidden, and 404 Resource not found. codeExamples has a single entry and that entry's response.statusCode is 200. No example response body is published for 301, 403, or 404. This cell does not invent error payloads.

response.schema.required includes language, and schema.properties.language is [string, null]. The 200 example object has no language key. descriptionHTML also says security_and_analysis is visible only with admin/owner/security-manager permissions; that key is absent from the example. Request parameters are placeholders OWNER/REPO, not octocat/Hello-World.

Docs URL query apiVersion=2022-11-28 disagrees with the visible curl header X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10. codeExamples.request.acceptHeader is application/vnd.github.v3+json; the visible curl Accept is application/vnd.github+json. descriptionHTML says parent and source are present when the repository is a fork, but the example has fork false while still including parent and source objects (both full_name octocat/Hello-World). This cell does not pick a winner and does not execute the live endpoint to resolve the disagreement.
